related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

observation.source_interface: mncs-env events and committed Environment/Control source

outcome.interpretation_limit: This is one observed Environment session and source review. It does not establish recurrence, user impact, or the cause of any duplicated work.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Read-only Environment RPC activity lacks durable operation-level session evidence
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Control Environment RPC and Environment session event projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A live Environment event read returned only generic resume/checkpoint event identities for recent read activity. Committed Control source maps campaign-state requests to the CLI and keeps idempotency responses in a bounded in-memory request map; committed Environment event and CLI source has named provider invocation events but no operation-specific event for campaign-state reads.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a bounded authenticated operation-observation source for read-only Environment RPCs, correlated to session, campaign, caller principal, environment/repository revision, operation identity, and outcome. Preserve only status and bounded summaries or digests, and make the existing Environment projection able to reference that source without copying transcripts or creating an unbounded telemetry store.
not_measured: which event sequences correspond to each individual RPC call

measured_fields: whether an operation result is present

supporting_sources.observed_contract: typed events include capability.invoked and invocation.completed but no named read-operation completion event
campaign_state and context return read results without recording an operation-specific session event
campaign_state RPC maps a bounded evidence page request to the Environment campaign-state command
RPC request/response idempotency records are retained in an in-process OrderedDict capped at 2048 entries

not_measured: whether direct context and campaign-state calls were duplicated by other consumers
whether a durable operation event source exists outside the inspected Environment session and Control RPC code
